INSERT INTO BUSC.MBK_RTBK_TRANSACTION_MTB
SELECT
	TXN_KEY
	,TXN_ID
	,MBX_APP_ID
	,TXN_TYPE
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, stuff(stuff(stuff(TXN_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as TXN_DATE
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,8),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TXN_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) as TXN_AMT
	,CUST_ID
	,FROM_ACCT_LINK_ID
	,FROM_ACCT_NO
	,FROM_ACCT_CCY
	,FROM_ACCT_ALIAS
	,FROM_BANK_ID
	,FROM_BANK_CODE
	,FROM_BANK_NAME
	,TO_ACCT_PAYEE_TYPE
	,TO_ACCT_LINK_ID
	,TO_ACCT_NO
	,TO_ACCT_CCY
	,TO_ACCT_ALIAS
	,TO_BANK_ID
	,TO_BANK_CODE
	,TO_BANK_NAME
	,TO_ACCT_REF1
	,TO_ACCT_REF2
	,TO_ACCT_REF3
	,TO_ACCT_REF4
	,TXN_FIELD1
	,TXN_FIELD2
	,TXN_FIELD3
	,TXN_DETAIL_REF_ID
	,SCHEDULED_TXN_REF_KEY
	,STATUS
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, stuff(stuff(stuff(STATUS_CHANGE_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as STATUS_CHANGE_DATE
	,REMARKS
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(12,8),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([XRATE],' ',''),''),0)) as XRATE
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,8),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([XRATE_EQUIV_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) as XRATE_EQUIV_AMT
	,TXN_FAILURE_CODE
	,TXN_FAILURE_TEXT
	,FLAGS
	,HOST_REF_NO
	,LOCATION
	,TXN_CHANNEL
	,PURPOSE
	,PCHCSEQ
	,1 AS ISACTIVE
	,1 AS ISLATEST
	,LEFT(FILE_NAME, 5) AS BNK_CODE
	,SUBSTRING(FILE_NAME,7,3) AS SOURCE_CODE
	,FILE_NAME
	,INSERT_DTTM
FROM d360.STG_MBK_RTBK_TRANSACTION_MTB
WHERE H = 'd'
